_comment: Row 243 / row 351: three behavioral regressions over the deterministic registrar state machine plus the exact process-wide time.sleep leak that made six downstream capture tests fail. The companion transform control applies M1 and M4 unchanged to an import-only test and both must ESCAPE.
subject: owned pytest registration resolves without ambient luck, fails closed, and restores shared clock state

M2 silence the proven no-registrar branch

mutants.label: M4 leak the Chromium probe's no-op sleep process-wide
mutants.old:
with monkeypatch.context() as scoped:
        scoped.setattr(module.time, "sleep", lambda _seconds: None)
        with pytest.raises(
            module.PytestRegistrationRefused,
            match=r"REGISTRATION FAILED:.*owner-boundary refusal",
        ):
            module.run_sample(0, False, outdir, "registration-refusal")
mutants.new:
module.time.sleep = lambda _seconds: None
    with pytest.raises(
        module.PytestRegistrationRefused,
        match=r"REGISTRATION FAILED:.*owner-boundary refusal",
    ):
        module.run_sample(0, False, outdir, "registration-refusal")
